item.title: New Ron DeSantis gallium statue unveiled in Tallahassee is melting in the sun – Uncommon New York reveals 'DENIAL' – a life-size statue of Florida Governor Ron DeSantis with supporters and onlookers in attendance. Hours later, it began to melt.
item.description:
I like how he morphs into Ron DeSkeletor.
DENIAL, a new installation from 350actionus, mssngpeces & Uncommon, is sculpted from gallium, a metal that melts below Tallahassee's average summer highs. It marks the moment Florida erased "climate change" from state law while spending more than $1 billion responding to floods, storms & heat. Once the applause fades, we're the ones left with the consequences.

item.title: GovBrief Today #626
item.description: Emiliano Andrade-Covarrubias had his medicine with him when he was detained, but his daughter says the staff at his ICE jail wouldn’t give it to him. The Dallas painter was jailed in June. Guards found him dead in his Laredo cell Saturday morning. His family learned of his death from the county medical examiner, because nobody from ICE called them. Emiliano told his family his chest felt tight and he was having trouble breathing. He said the medical staff “would just ignore him.” ICE’s own detention rules say the people it holds shall receive continuity of care. On Monday his daughter, an American citizen, goes to the jail to collect his personal effects. I’ve emailed 9,572 stories over 626 straight nights, free and without ads. item.description: FOUR ERAS OF HISTORY IN ONE BUILDING In Istanbul’s historic Fatih district, a remarkable building reveals architectural layers associated with four different periods: the Roman Empire, the Byzantine Empire, the Ottoman Empire, and the modern Turkish Republic. Its lowest section is believed to contain the remains of a Roman-era cistern, with Byzantine arches, Ottoman masonry, and more recent construction rising above it. The structure offers a rare visual timeline of nearly 1,800 years of Istanbul’s architectural history.
